bias.en: Uptrend · reclaimed the 100-day, SAR turned bullish
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 收复 100 日均线，SAR 转多

read.en: TSMC rose 2.9% on Oct 27 to $436.87, trading between $426.00 and $438.58. It is above the rising 5-day ($424.8), the falling 10-day ($423.4) and 100-day ($429.5) and the rising 200-day ($398.7), and below the falling 30-day ($443.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 27 ($407.13), and RSI is 51.
read.zh: 台积电 10月27日上涨 2.9%，收于 $436.87，盘中区间 $426.00–438.58。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$424.8）、下行的 10 日（$423.4）和 100 日均线（$429.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$398.7）上方，低于下行的 30 日均线（$443.4）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 于 10月27日转为看多（$407.13），RSI 为 51。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 100-day ($429.5) and cleared the $435.2 Oct 21 high, both now support. Resistance is $438.6 (Oct 27 high), then $443.4–445.5 (30-day, Oct 13 high) and $454.4 (Oct 12 high). Support is $428.9–429.5 (100-day, Oct 26 high), then $423.4–426 (5 and 10-day, Oct 27 low) and $407–412.5 (SAR, Sep 15 low). A close above $445.5 would target $454; below $429, $424.

s.en: 100-day average $429.5, reclaimed; Oct 26 high $428.9; Oct 21 high $435.2, cleared
Sep 15 low $412.5; Oct 22 low $410.2; Parabolic SAR $407.1
